Patriot Wealth Management Has Decreased United Rentals Com (URI) Stake by $3.79 Million as Stock Rose; Viacom New Cl B (VIAB) Holder Thompson Investment Management Lifted Holding by $1.34 Million
May 18, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Thompson Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Viacom Inc New Cl B (VIAB) by 22.62% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Thompson Investment Management Inc bought 44,811 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.65% with the market. The institutional investor held 242,913 shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.48 million, up from 198,102 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Thompson Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Viacom Inc New Cl B for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $11.36 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.78% or $0.5 during the last trading session, reaching $27.66. About 1.83M shares traded. Viacom, Inc. (NASDAQ:VIAB) has declined 30.65% since May 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.20% the S&P500.
Patriot Wealth Management Inc decreased its stake in United Rentals Inc Com (URI) by 49.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Patriot Wealth Management Inc sold 22,137 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.52% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 22,590 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.88M, down from 44,727 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Patriot Wealth Management Inc who had been investing in United Rentals Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $14.27B market cap company. The stock increased 0.22% or $0.37 during the last trading session, reaching $170.73. About 240,383 shares traded. United Rentals, Inc. (NYSE:URI) has risen 48.17% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 36.62% the S&P500.
Among 23 analysts covering United Rentals Inc. ( NYSE:URI ), 7 have Buy rating, 4 Sell and 12 Hold. Therefore 30% are positive. United Rentals Inc. had 78 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Bank of America maintained United Rentals, Inc. (NYSE:URI) rating on Thursday, July 20. Bank of America has “Buy” rating and $145 target. The stock has “Buy” rating by Bank of America on Tuesday, December 19. The firm has “Overweight” rating given on Wednesday, October 12 by Barclays Capital. The rating was upgraded by Longbow on Monday, January 18 to “Buy”. (NYSE:URI) rating on Friday, October 13. Citigroup has “Buy” rating and $165 target. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Thursday, August 18 by Bank of America. Stifel Nicolaus maintained United Rentals, Inc. (NYSE:URI) on Sunday, December 10 with “Buy” rating. The stock of United Rentals, Inc. (NYSE:URI) has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, May 25 by RBC Capital Markets.

Patriot Wealth Management Inc, which manages about $1.25B and $705.94 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Microsoft Corp Com (NASDAQ:MSFT) by 13,141 shares to 140,292 shares, valued at $12.00 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc Com (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 12,533 shares in the quarter, for a total of 113,150 shares, and has risen its stake in Delta Air Lines Inc Del Com New (NYSE:DAL).
